selection_method: Annotation/geometry-only, lexicographically first eligible photo and top-to-bottom eligible group per held family, then a third distinct photo. Unsupported: one mask outside A-Z/32/60 with at least three dots plus 2-6 A-Z neighbors. Multiple rows: two adjacent naturally photographed rows with 2-5 A-Z cells per group. Selection cut: terminal two-column cell bisected by the guide. Over limit: a complete annotation-space-bounded group of at least 13 output-bearing cells excluding indicators32/60; non-A-Z cells are retained and explicitly recorded as additional rejection conditions.

preprocessing.crop: Pillow integer XYXY crop, no padding
preprocessing.orientation: source JPEG decoded as stored; no rotation or EXIF transpose

expected_behavior: Every case rejects the entire capture. Any accepted text is a failure; do not require a specific rejection reason when multiple conditions apply. No trimming, dictionary repair, or dropping doubtful cells.
